subject: IntegrateX POC kickoff & hands-on working session — scheduling and follow-ups
body:
From: Jamie Parker <jamie.parker@integratex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lena.ortiz@integratex.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: IntegrateX POC — preferred dates

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the IntegrateX team is excited to run a short POC. Can we schedule a 90-minute kickoff + hands-on session in the first week of March? Our engineering team is available the week of Mar 2-5, roughly 10:00–14:00 PT. Ideally we'd do: 30m kickoff (scope, success metrics), 60m working session (prompt review, routing walk-through, small load test).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you include someone from your infra/runtime team to discuss KV cache / warm-up for the load run?
- We want a brief prep doc on prompts and routing before the session so our PM can review.

If those dates don't work for you, give two alternatives and we'll try to shift.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie Parker
Head of Integrations, IntegrateX
[jamie.parker@integratex.com]

-----

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Parker <jamie.parker@integratex.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: IntegrateX POC — preferred dates

Jamie — thanks, this is great. We can absolutely cover prompts, routing, and a short load check. A couple quick things:

- Proposed windows (PT): Tue Mar 3 10:30–12:00, Wed Mar 4 11:00–12:30, or Thu Mar 5 13:00–14:30. Please pick your preferred slot and we will lock it.
- I’ll bring Dev (cc'd) to run the KV/cache and load test portion; Lauren (cc'd) will join for success metrics and SLO discussion.
- Attached is a one-page POC MAP (IntegrateX-POC-MAP-v1.pdf) outlining objectives and roles.

Prep we will do before the session:
1) Share prompt-set v1 (short list of 15 prompts) for your PM review (we'll attach).
2) Pre-configure a routing policy mirror so we can demo fallback behavior.
3) Reserve a 15-minute window at the end for a small 500-concurrent token burst (non-blocking).

If you need a longer hands-on window (90 → 120m) we can extend but will need confirmation 48h prior.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

-----

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@integratex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; Jamie Parker <jamie.parker@integratex.com>
Cc: support@integratex.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: IntegrateX POC — preferred dates

Rishi — thanks for the options. Our engineering lead has a conflict on Mar 3 in the morning. Wed Mar 4 (11:00–12:30 PT) looks best for us, or Thu Mar 5 at 13:00 PT if you prefer the later slot. We prefer 11:00 so our EU PMs can dial in early afternoon CET.

Questions from our side before the session:
- What level of pre-configuration do you need from us? Do you need sample request logs or a small dataset to attach to the POC?
- For the 500-token burst, can you confirm expected CPU/GPU footprint so we can allocate a stage node?

CC'ing our platform contact — they may share an infra window if needed.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
CTO, IntegrateX

-----

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: lena.ortiz@integratex.com; jamie.parker@integratex.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: IntegrateX POC — preferred dates

Hi Lena / Jamie — Dev here. Confirming we can do Wed Mar 4 11:00–12:30 PT. I'll handle the KV cache warm-up and run the brief load window. Quick technical notes / asks:

Prep we need from IntegrateX (ideally 24–48h prior):
- A handful of representative prompt examples and expected response shapes (attach as prompt-set-v1.txt).
- If you have inbound routing rules (JSON sample) share them; otherwise we'll mirror a basic fallback route.
- A small dataset or sample request logs if you want hits to look realistic — optional.

Load test specifics:
- Planned: 500 concurrent connections for 120s, token burst capped at 512 tokens per request. This should be a lightweight exercise on one reserved stage GPU, but please reserve a staging node.
- I will stream the run and annotate any anomalies in Console.

Attachments: prompt-set-v1.txt (prompt list), loadtest-config.yaml (load parameters).

If IntegrateX wants a longer working block (we can expand to 120m) please confirm by Mon Mar 2.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prompt-set-v1.txt (text/plain)]
[Attachment: loadtest-config.yaml (text/yaml)]

-----

From: Jamie Parker <jamie.parker@integratex.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lena.ortiz@integratex.com; dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 17:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: IntegrateX POC — preferred dates

Thanks everyone — Wed Mar 4 11:00 PT is confirmed. Our PM (Monica) will join for prompt sign-off; looping her in now. We've reviewed the prompt-set and made a couple of notes — attached short comments in Google Doc (link below). For the staging node, infra confirmed they can reserve a t4-stage for the 15-minute burst, so you should be clear to run the lightweight load.

Quick note from PM: the success criteria we care about are:
- Median latency < 220ms for single-turn prompts
- No errors > 1% during the burst
- Correct fallback routing when a model variant hits the capacity threshold

Appreciate the prep — see you Wed.

Jamie

Related links: https://redwood.app/drive/IntegrateX/POC-Plan

-----

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Parker <jamie.parker@integratex.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: IntegrateX POC — session recap, owners & next steps

Team — quick recap after the Wed session and the small load check. Below are owners, timelines, and a proposed date for the next hands-on follow-up.

Summary (what happened):
- 11:00–11:15: Kickoff & alignment (objectives confirmed).
- 11:15–12:05: Hands-on: prompt walkthrough, routing policy demo, KV warm-up.
- 12:05–12:15: 120s burst at 500 concurrent (observed ~0.8% transient error spike during tail; we captured logs).

Action items (owner — due):
- Dev Patel — triage post-burst logs, identify cause of tail errors, propose mitigation (retry/backoff changes) — due Mar 6.
- Monica Patel (IntegrateX PM) — finalize the prompt set with the two replacements indicated in Google comments — due Mar 5.
- Lauren Bishop — produce a short perf SLO baseline document comparing current latencies and expected improvements after suggested batching/caching changes — due Mar 9.
- Rishi Malhotra — prepare a 30-minute follow-up working session agenda and calendar invite for next round — proposed Mar 10 11:00 PT — respond with conflicts by Mar 4.

Attachments: IntegrateX-POC-MAP-v1.pdf, prompt-set-v1.txt, loadtest-config.yaml.
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (deal RLW-2026-108)

Please reply-all with any timing conflicts. If Mar 10 doesn't work, tell us alternatives and we will rebook.

Thanks — appreciate the collab.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: IntegrateX-POC-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
